content: We use the standard back-propagation method to train the model parameters, the same as the baseline model. In order to incorporate the term of the argmax part of Formula 24 , we follow the previous work of adversarial training BIBREF13 , BIBREF15 , BIBREF17 , by introducing a gradient reverse layer between the common Bi-LSTM and the CNN module, whose forward does nothing but the backward simply negates the gradients.
